title: heatExchanger operation
description: Two-stream heat exchanger. FOUR modes via `model`: epsNTU (default) rates from a given U + area; geometry COMPUTES U + area + pressure drop from the tube bundle (Gnielinski/Kern); design SIZES the bundle from a duty target; BellDelaware rates the declared bundle with the Bell-Delaware shell side (the baffle-cut, leakage and bypass factors; JL, JB, RL, RB are Bell's chart readings and are declared). In geometry/design/BellDelaware the U and area below are RESULTS, not inputs.

area.title: Heat-transfer area
area.description: Heat-transfer surface. SIMPLE mode only — with U it fixes the duty. A geometry-mode exchanger computes both from its hardware instead, which is why neither is required here.

U.title: Overall heat-transfer coefficient
U.description: Overall coefficient, referred to `area`. SIMPLE mode only; in geometry mode it EMERGES from the shell- and tube-side correlations and is reported rather than entered.

passes.title: Tube passes
passes.description: Number of tube passes, for the LMTD correction factor; defaults to 1.

tubeStream.title: Tube-side stream
tubeStream.description: Which of the two inlets runs through the tubes. Required in geometry mode: shell and tube side see different correlations, so the assignment changes the answer and is not the engine's to guess.

geometry.title: Shell-and-tube hardware
geometry.description: Present = GEOMETRY mode: U is computed from the two film coefficients and the wall, instead of being entered. This is the rating/design route.

tubePattern.title: Tube layout
tubePattern.description: e.g. triangular or square — it changes the shell-side crossflow area.

wallMaterial.title: Wall material
wallMaterial.description: Resolved by name in the assets catalogue for its thermal conductivity.

shellSide.title: Shell-side film model
shellSide.description: Which correlation prices the shell-side film coefficient.

tubeSide.title: Tube-side film model
tubeSide.description: Which correlation prices the tube-side film coefficient.

design.title: Design specification
design.description: Turns the geometry pass into a DESIGN: solve the hardware for a declared target instead of rating what is given.

bellDelaware.title: Bell-Delaware shell side
bellDelaware.description: Used with `model BellDelaware;`. Form Hewitt (default): Hewitt, Shires & Bott, Process Heat Transfer, Section 6.3.2. Form Serth: Serth, Process Heat Transfer (2007), Sections 6.3-6.7. Each of JL, JB (and RL, RB for the pressure drop) is Bell's chart reading DECLARED as a number, or the word `auto` for Taborek's closed form (HEDH 3.3); JL and JB are required (the choice is the student's), RL and RB both or neither.

baffleCutPercent.title: Baffle cut
baffleCutPercent.description: Percent of the shell diameter; 15 to 45 (the window of the linear Jc fit).

sealingStripRatio.title: Sealing strips per cross-flow row
sealingStripRatio.description: N_ss/N_c, the chart parameter of Hewitt Fig 6.9.

sealingStripPairs.title: Pairs of sealing strips
sealingStripPairs.description: Alternative to the ratio; N_ss/N_c is then derived.

baffleThickness.title: Baffle thickness
baffleThickness.description: With the tube length gives the number of baffles.

nBaffles.title: Number of baffles
nBaffles.description: Overrides the count derived from the tube length.

JL.title: Leakage correction JL
JL.description: A number read from Hewitt Fig 6.8, or `auto`: 0.44(1-r_s) + [1-0.44(1-r_s)] exp(-2.2 r_lm). Required.

JB.title: Bypass correction JB
JB.description: A number read from Hewitt Fig 6.9, or `auto`: exp[-C F_sbp (1-(2 N_ss/N_c)^(1/3))], C = 1.35 (Re <= 100) or 1.25, 1 for N_ss/N_c >= 1/2. Required.

RL.title: Leakage pressure-drop factor RL
RL.description: A number read from Hewitt Fig 6.10, or `auto`: exp[-1.33 (1+r_s) r_lm^p], p = 0.8 - 0.15 (1+r_s). With RB turns on the shell pressure drop.

RB.title: Bypass pressure-drop factor RB
RB.description: A number read from Hewitt Fig 6.11, or `auto`: exp[-C_bp F_sbp (1-(2 N_ss/N_c)^(1/3))], C_bp = 4.5 (Re <= 100) or 3.7, 1 for N_ss/N_c >= 1/2.

form.title: Form of the method
form.description: Hewitt (default: J_s = 1, J_r not applied, diametral clearances) or Serth (Serth Sections 6.3-6.7 as printed: his flow areas, J_S, J_R, R_S computed, the end-zone assembly of Eq 6.15; needs idealBank Serth and clearanceBasis; a laminar shell flow, Re < 100, is refused for the pressure drop).

clearanceBasis.title: Clearance basis (form Serth)
clearanceBasis.description: Required with form Serth, never defaulted: `radial` uses tubeBaffleClearance and shellBaffleClearance as the gap itself (Serth Eqs 6.22, 6.36 as his Example 6.1 inserts them; reproduces the example), `diametral` halves them.

jIdeal.title: Ideal-bank j (form Serth)
jIdeal.description: Optional chart reading of the Colburn j (Serth Fig 6.1) in place of Eqs 6.1-6.4.

fIdeal.title: Ideal-bank f (form Serth)
fIdeal.description: Optional chart reading of the ideal-bank friction factor in place of Eqs 6.2, 6.4.

baffleSpacingInlet.title: Inlet baffle spacing (form Serth)
baffleSpacingInlet.description: Default: the central spacing; drives J_S and R_S (Eqs 6.54-6.55).
